title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(岡本正人研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Okamoto Masato)
keywords: Aeronautical engineering 2.Aerodynamics 3.Flight dynamics 4.Steady and unsteady wings 5.Regional contribution
educationalGoal: The objective of this course is to develop a basic ability to design, manufacture, and make feasible proposals for aircraft design, the application of aeronautical engineering theory, and the evaluation of actual phenomena related to aircraft.
advice: Specific project themes will be determined through discussion, and problems will be discovered and resolved according to these discussions. Themes can be broadly classified as follows. (1) Basic research on themes such as the aerodynamic characteristics of wings. (2) Demonstration and evaluation by proposing new aircraft such as small drones (3) Research on the aerodynamic characteristics of flying creatures in nature and examination of applied technology
requiredKnowledge: As Design Project III is based on previous lectures, experiments and exercises in the department of aeronautical systems engineering, it is necessary to review them.

activityGoals.body: Be able to define project themes and act on engineering design processes.
Be able to summarize in reports, and present and discuss the reports.
Be able to design, draft, manufacture (production), simulate, etc.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain the purpose of the project theme and the process, and achieve annual goals that are suitable for the purpose. (2) Summarize as an interim report, and present and discuss the report. Summarize as a project report and present and discuss in a public presentation review meeting. The final results can be published as an academic paper and receive an external evaluation. (3) Design and manufacture experimental equipment, and evaluate the performance of the product.
